Paraneoplastic guard for both edges: in the IIM meta-analysis dysphagia is also a marker of increased cancer risk (RR 2.09) and ILD of reduced cancer risk (RR 0.49) (Oldroyd 2021); a dysphagia or ILD presentation in DM requires concurrent malignancy workup, so any secondary claim must record whether a paraneoplastic phenotype was excluded.
governanceNotes: Both edges authored at ASSOCIATION_ONLY with NOT_ESTABLISHED consensus and hypothesizedOnly mechanisms, following the scleroderma -> interstitial-lung-disease precedent: ILD and dysphagia are defining-feature-level associations of a systemic autoimmune disease, but subtype heterogeneity (classic vs amyopathic vs anti-synthetase vs anti-MDA5), autoantibody-stratified phenotypes, and treatment-era cohorts prevent a population-level causal quantification without individual subtype documentation.

Mortality-direction guard: ILD is the dominant mortality predictor in DM cohorts (HR 3.57, Fornaro 2024), so the ILD edge carries severity documentation requirements disproportionate to its rank position.

nexusClaim.associationBasis: The IIM cohort (n=91) found interstitial lung disease in 43.8% of clinically amyopathic DM versus 15.9% of classic DM, and ILD was the strongest mortality predictor overall (HR 3.57) (Fornaro 2024); the 69-study IIM meta-analysis documents ILD as an established clinical factor with inverse paraneoplastic weighting (RR 0.49 for cancer) (Oldroyd 2021); the 546-patient DM cancer-prediction model explicitly scores ILD as an inverse cancer-likelihood factor (Ye 2026).
nexusClaim.causationStatus: Neither causation nor aggravation is established at the mapping level: ILD in dermatomyositis is subtype-stratified (amyopathic DM, anti-MDA5, anti-synthetase phenotypes) with prevalence spanning roughly 16%-44% across subtypes; the autoimmune-lung pathway is the accepted biology but no cohort quantifies incident ILD attributable to DM within the heterogeneous population; and malignancy workup is standard in DM, so competing paraneoplastic or drug-induced lung injury must be excluded before any individual attribution.

causalMechanism.primaryVector: A hypothesized autoimmune-interstitial pathway: dermatomyositis autoimmunity (type-I interferon signature, myositis-specific antibodies) targets capillary endothelium and mesenchyme as well as muscle and skin; alveolar-interstitial inflammation progresses through a nonspecific interstitial pneumonia or organizing-pneumonia pattern to fibrotic interstitial lung disease. The pathway's expression is antibody-dependent (anti-MDA5 and anti-synthetase carry the highest ILD risk), so the same disease label spans phenotypes with different lung trajectories.

evidentiaryProfile.conservativeRationale: Subtype heterogeneity (classic vs amyopathic, antibody-defined phenotypes) prevents population-level quantification; paraneoplastic workup is standard in DM and malignancy-associated myositis confounds attribution; drug-induced pneumonitis (methotrexate, biologics) and aspiration-related lung change are competing causes; no incident-cohort denominator exists.
evidentiaryProfile.evidenceGaps: HRCT and PFT documentation of ILD pattern with chronology relative to DM onset; myositis-specific-antibody panel placing the ILD in its phenotype; exclusion of drug-induced pneumonitis and paraneoplastic lung involvement; severity documentation (FVC, DLCO)
alternativeEtiologiesToRuleOut: Malignancy-associated myositis with paraneoplastic lung disease
Anti-synthetase syndrome as a distinct antibody-defined entity
Aspiration-related lung disease in myopathic dysphagia

evidenceGaps: high-resolution CT and pulmonary-function documentation of ILD pattern (NSIP, organizing pneumonia, usual interstitial pneumonia) with chronology relative to DM onset

nexusClaim.associationBasis: The IIM systematic review and meta-analysis (69 studies) documents dysphagia as an established clinical factor of the disease, associated with increased cancer risk (RR 2.09) in the paraneoplastic direction (Oldroyd 2021); the therapeutic-rationale review lists dysphagia among the core clinical features of DM (Paik 2025); the dedicated prognosis report confirms pharyngeal/upper-esophageal involvement as a clinically tracked manifestation (Ogawa-Momohara 2019).
nexusClaim.causationStatus: Neither causation nor aggravation is established at the mapping level: inflammatory involvement of striated pharyngeal and upper-esophageal muscle is the accepted biology, but no cohort quantifies incident dysphagia in the general DM population; dysphagia marks the severe myositis phenotype and simultaneously flags malignancy-associated myositis; glucocorticoid myopathy and cricopharyngeal dysfunction are competing mechanisms producing the same symptom.

causalMechanism.primaryVector: A hypothesized inflammatory-myopathy pathway: dermatomyositis autoimmunity involves striated muscle beyond the limb girdles, including the pharyngeal constrictors and upper esophageal sphincter; inflammatory infiltration and perifascicular atrophy weaken the swallowing musculature, producing nasal regurgitation, cough with swallows, and penetrations/aspirations; velopharyngeal incompetence and cricopharyngeal spasm can compound the deficit. Steroid-induced proximal myopathy is a competing mechanism once treatment begins.

evidentiaryProfile.conservativeRationale: No incidence denominator in the general DM population; phenotype and paraneoplastic confounding (dysphagia flags cancer-associated myositis); competing steroid-myopathy and cricopharyngeal mechanisms; and the association evidence is expert-review and cohort-structure level rather than quantified incidence - association strength is the supportable ceiling.
evidentiaryProfile.evidenceGaps: Video-fluoroscopic or FEES swallowing study with chronology relative to DM onset; active-myositis documentation at onset; exclusion of steroid myopathy and cricopharyngeal dysfunction; recorded malignancy-workup status

evidenceGaps: video-fluoroscopic or fiberoptic-endoscopic swallowing study documenting the pharyngeal/upper-esophageal pattern with chronology relative to DM onset

suggestions.rationale: Authored at ASSOCIATION_ONLY: accepted inflammatory biology but no incidence denominator, phenotype confounding, and a documented paraneoplastic marker role; no causal claim is forced.
